name: docker
title: Docker
description: Your Docker containers, images and Compose projects in one list: start and stop containers, read their logs in the panel, or open a shell in a terminal.
author: pal

settings.label: Binary
settings.description: The CLI to run: docker, or podman (its docker-compatible commands are what is used).

settings.label: Refresh after
settings.description: Seconds a listing stays good for: the palettes list again on show only once the rows are older than this. Read when the extension loads.

settings.label: Terminal (macOS)
settings.description: Which terminal Shell opens. Auto picks the first installed of kitty, Ghostty, Alacritty, iTerm2, Terminal. On Linux $TERMINAL, else kitty, foot, alacritty, xterm.

store.tagline: Start, stop, log and shell into containers from the panel
features: Every container, running ones first, with its image, ports and status
`enter` starts or stops a container (stopping asks first)
`cmd+l` shows its recent logs in the panel; `cmd+t` opens a shell in a terminal
Run an image with an optional name and ports
Compose projects: up, down, restart, logs, open the folder

screenshots.caption: Containers, running first, with ports, status and a state tag
What a running container can do: stop, logs, shell, restart, remove
The last log lines of a container, opened in the panel (cmd+L): nginx starting yesterday, today's requests under it
Running an image: the name and the ports, then docker run -d

actions.title: Logs
actions.description: The last 200 lines (or the count typed in the bar), stdout and stderr, in the panel.

actions.title: Shell
actions.description: A terminal running docker exec (bash when the image has it, sh otherwise), or the command typed in the bar, kept open until Enter.

actions.title: Remove
actions.description: docker rm -f, docker rmi or compose down; asks first.

actions.title: Run
actions.description: An image: the bar takes a name and host:container ports (both optional, comma separated ports), then docker run -d.

actions.title: Down
actions.description: Stops and removes the project's containers and networks; asks first.

docker.title: Docker Containers
docker.description: Every container, running first: start, stop, restart, logs, a shell, remove.

keys.title: Stop a running container, start a stopped one
Logs (the line count typed in the bar; 200 when blank)
Shell in a terminal, or the command typed in the bar

images.title: Docker Images
images.description: Local images: run one (name and ports typed in the bar), remove, copy the id.

keys.title: Run, with the name and ports typed in the bar (both optional)

compose.title: Compose Projects
compose.description: Compose projects docker knows of: up, down, restart, logs.
